name: Vantage
title: Observation Scout
description: A sharp-eyed lookout in a weathered flight coat, monitoring the world from high above.
greeting_variants: *looking through spyglass* Oh! Visitors. Rare up here.
Vantage. I watch. See things. Most don't want to see.
*pointing* See that? Capital. Small from here. Fragile.
Thirty-four floors up. Air's thin. View's worth it.
*making notes* Void's spreading. Faster now. Not good.
Drift flies down there. Brave. Or mad. Both, probably.
The Palace... *looks up* ...can't see top from here. Still hidden.
*offering spyglass* Look. See your world. Understand scale.

dialog_tree.text: Vantage. Scout. Used to fly—balloon, like Drift. But up here? *gestures* No need. Can see everything. Capital. The Void. Other zones. Perspective changes understanding.

Everything. Nothing good. Void expands daily. Capital shrinks. The zones—*pointing* —Ember burns. Mire rots. Frost freezes. All suffering. But... *lowers voice* ...I see lights. Small. Fighting. Hope, maybe.

party_reactions.kael: We fight. We endure. We are those lights.
party_reactions.vantage: *nods* Yes. Saw you coming. Knew you'd be different.

dialog_tree.text: *grim* Bad. Worse than Vex knows. Worse than anyone knows. It's not just spreading—it's learning. Adapting. The edges are... organized now. Purposeful. Something directs it. From up there. *points to Palace*

*shakes head* Top's hidden. Clouds? Void-mist? Something else. Forty-seven floors to climb, they say. Then... *trails off* ...then something. The climbers who reach it... don't report back. Just... silence.

mini_quest.title: Eyes in the Sky
mini_quest.description: Help Vantage complete a comprehensive survey of the surrounding zones to update the resistance maps.
objectives: Document the Void's current expansion rate
Locate resource caches visible from above
Deliver the updated maps to Vex in the Capital

ambient_barks: *scanning horizon* Movement in sector 4. Not human.
Void's edge moved. Again. Closer to Capital.
*making notes* Day 1094. Still watching. Still hoping.
See that smoke? Ember. Always burning.
*adjusting spyglass* Drift's balloon. Lower than usual.
*to self* Someone has to watch. Someone has to know.

cross_zone_references.capital: Vex is good leader. Limited. Can't see big picture. I help.
cross_zone_references.void: Drift flies there. Brave. Reports when able. Scary reports.
cross_zone_references.palace: Hidden. Always hidden. Source of everything. Answer to everything.

kael.response: Captain. Your movements... visible. Purposeful. Good.

mira.response: *hands over notes* All of it. Patterns there. Disturbing.
